svg.desc: Bubo: agentic AI code review. AI code review that only speaks when it has something to say. Self-hosted, BYO-LLM, with the provenance, governance, and audit trail regulated teams need. Provenance, governance, compliance, observability. GitLab, GitHub, Codex or Claude, MCP server. github.com/mountainowl/bubo
